requirement_preview:
## Jira story HMA-401957
Summary: Basic Multi-armed Bandit option for A/B testing
Type: Story | Status: In Development
Components: - | Labels: -
Description / Acceptance criteria:
In addition to existing options in A/B testing for selecting the branch, we will add multi-armed bandit ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multi-armed_bandit|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multi-armed_bandit|smart-link] ) as a move towards integrating more AI capability, even though we only implement the basic case.

To do this, the below new configuration settings are added to A/B test UI

# Threshold on total presentation of all the branches.
# Minimum percentage (minPer) to be selected for for random selection.

This is how it works

# Initially, the branches are selected randomly based on the initial configured percentage
# When the threshold is reached, the random selection is applied in only minPercentage of the cases; while the branch with the highest acceptance rate is selected for the rest. For example, if minPer=10, random selection is applied in 10% of the getOffers call, and the best performant branch is selected in 90% of the cases.
# The best performant branch is dynamically evaluated, although not necessarily for every getOffers call. The evaluation for best offer should consider the recent data rather than considering the contact & accept counts from the beginning. The logic for “recent data“ is to be decided.
